purpose: Teach: 歯ブラシ/酪農/石器/ニワトリ/和紙/魚介類/アヒル/下駄

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、歯ブラシをちゃんと使いましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's make sure you're brushing your teeth properly, all right?
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact reminder. Gentle but direct. The tone of someone who has said this a hundred times and will say it a hundred more — no frustration, just steady parental presence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、酪農のお話を授業で聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I heard about dairy farms in class today!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick pace, animated. The rush of a six-year-old who can't wait to share something he learned. Seeking her attention and approval in the same breath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが石器のレプリカ見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Your grandfather showed you a replica of a stone tool, didn't he.
lines.style: Warm, reflective — not quite a question. Soft landing on the statement. The tone of someone gently marking a moment, acknowledging something her son has experienced without needing to make a production of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、田舎の家でニワトリ追いかけたよ
lines.en: Mom, I chased chickens at the country house!
lines.style: Bright, present-tense energy. Quick words tumbling out. The delight of recounting something that happened — not asking permission, just sharing the joy of the memory with immediate enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが和紙のうちわを買ってこられたわ
lines.en: Your father brought home a washi fan for you.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact observation. Quiet satisfaction in her voice — noting small kindnesses without fanfare. Slight pause before the word 'fan,' as though picturing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの魚介類のお料理大好き
lines.en: Mom, I love Grandma's cooking — especially the seafood dishes.
lines.style: Warm, genuine delight. Open and unguarded. The naturalness of a child who knows he is safe saying what he loves without performance or hesitation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんと池でアヒルを見ましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go see the ducks with your grandfather at the pond.
lines.style: Tender, inviting. Soft vowels on 'ducks.' Gentle cadence — the suggestion of something shared and gentle. A moment being offered, not imposed. Quiet warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの下駄借りたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to borrow Grandpa's geta sandals.
lines.style: Direct request with underlying affection. Present and eager but softer than earlier lines — not demanding, asking. The specific detail of 'geta' carries real longing, a concrete anchor for wanting to be like his grandfather.
